name: Song With Lag
description: When the game lags, the song lags with it, so the level and the music stay in sync.

enabled.name: Song lags with the game
enabled.description: When a frame takes too long, the level moves on by one ordinary frame instead of jumping ahead, and the song is wound back by the time the game spent frozen.

threshold-ms.name: Lag threshold (ms)
threshold-ms.description: A frame longer than this counts as lag. At 60 FPS an ordinary frame is about 17 ms; on a high refresh rate screen you can lower this.

show-notice.name: Show what was absorbed
show-notice.description: Briefly shows in the top-right corner how many milliseconds the song was wound back.

check-updates.name: Check for updates
check-updates.description: Downloads the newest release straight from GitHub. Restart the game afterwards to apply it.
